Summary: Scripture opens with God speaking light into darkness, and that contrast runs through the whole Bible as a picture of good and evil, truth and falsehood, life and death. Jesus declared Himself the Light of the World, and His followers are called to shine as lights in a dark world. In the new creation, darkness will be gone forever.
KeyPassages: Genesis 1:3-4; Psalm 27:1; Isaiah 9:2; John 1:5; John 8:12; Ephesians 5:8; Revelation 22:5
